understood_as: Run the next sequential gates after implementation: first an eight-cell CPU minimal smoke, then an eight-cell 512x64 GPU one-update smoke only if CPU passes and an idle GPU is available.

authorization.source: user continuation instruction after the implementation handoff, followed by explicit instruction to stop the dummy GPU process and train
authorization.process_termination_scope: SIGTERM only for identity-checked processes carrying --beyondg-gpu-keepalive during the smoke and authorized development handoff; no authority for any other process

execution_identity.scope: the base commit plus the exact runtime artifact hashes recorded below
execution_identity.result_invalidation: a change to any shared runtime artifact invalidates the recorded CPU evidence and requires all eight CPU cells to pass again before GPU entry

gpu.entry_gate: all eight CPU cells pass and the selected GPU has no conflicting active compute process
gpu.process_isolation: one fresh process per method x environment cell, executed sequentially
gpu.conflict_definition: any other process on the selected device UUID that actively computes or holds device memory is conflicting
gpu.fresh_entry_check: repeat the process, memory, and utilization check immediately before every cell; an earlier observation is only point-in-time evidence
gpu.noninterference: never signal, terminate, suspend, or otherwise interfere with a conflicting process without separate explicit authority

execution_contract.order: run the eight cells sequentially, with a fresh process for every method x environment pair
execution_contract.output: each cell must emit one JSON result on stdout and exit zero; stdout and stderr may be retained only under /tmp; no persistent run or checkpoint directory is created
execution_contract.replay_scope: PQN, LEO, and Dual retain no rollout replay; SD-SAC may use only the declared transient in-memory replay, which is discarded at process exit

smoke_only_optimizer_inputs.selection_boundary: these values exist only to exercise finite forward, target, loss, optimizer, replay, and target-update paths; they are not development candidates and cannot populate the empty candidate registry without a reviewed amendment

pass_criteria: every cell initializes on the requested backend
every cell collects exactly the declared physical transitions
every online method applies its declared update without retaining rollout replay
SD-SAC stores behavior entropy, has at least one valid replay transition, and applies one replay update iteration
all reported losses, parameters, optimizer states, target states, and counters are finite
no checkpoint, run directory, queue claim, or dependency mutation is created
failure_rule: stop the affected tier and preserve stdout and stderr under /tmp; this manifest does not authorize source edits, implementation fixes, dependency changes, or any additional process termination; require a reviewed amendment before any such action; after any shared runtime code change, rerun all eight CPU cells before GPU entry; do not open development

amendments.authority: explicit user instruction to stop the dummy and train
amendments.action: verified PID 107 as --beyondg-gpu-keepalive, sent SIGTERM, and confirmed zero remaining GPU compute processes and zero MiB device use
amendments.contract_fix: changed JAX_PLATFORMS from the generic gpu alias to the installed NVIDIA backend name cuda
amendments.reason: the first TICK-CLAIM x GC-PQN attempt exited before model initialization because the generic alias attempted the unavailable ROCm backend
amendments.scope: execution contract and manifest test only; no shared runtime code changed, so the passed CPU evidence remains valid

gpu.reason: the dummy keepalive was explicitly terminated before each fresh process; all cells passed after the recorded cuda platform amendment
gpu.observation_scope: point-in-time evidence only; the full GPU entry check must be repeated immediately before every future cell

failed_attempts.failure: JAX_PLATFORMS=gpu attempted the unavailable rocm backend before model initialization

verification.gpu_recheck: all eight 512x64 cells passed after each newly recreated dummy keepalive was identity-checked and terminated immediately before the fresh smoke process
